title: The canonical coefficient equivalence intertwines constant-module transitions
statement: Fix a universe $u$, a commutative ring $\Lambda$ and a module $M$ in universe $u+1$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], a scheme $X$ and an etale object $U\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $A=\mathrm{Ab}$, let $V:\Lambda\text{-Mod}\to A$ forget scalars, and put $C_X=(VM)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For a morphism $f:Z\to X$, define a sheaf isomorphism $j_f:V(M_Z)\to f^{-1}C_X$ to be the canonical constantCommuteCompose comparison $V(M_Z)\to(VM)_Z$, followed by the inverse of the canonical constant-sheaf pullback comparison $f^{-1}C_X\to(VM)_Z$. Evaluating $j_f$ at $U\times_X Z$ gives an additive equivalence $c_f:(f_*M_Z)(U)\to(f_*f^{-1}C_X)(U)$; forgetting scalars commutes definitionally with direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $g:W\to Z$, $h:W\to X$ and $g f=h$. Let $T_M:(f_*M_Z)(U)\to(h_*M_W)(U)$ be constantModulePushforwardMap [lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-pushforward-functoriality]. Let $T_A:(f_*f^{-1}C_X)(U)\to(h_*h^{-1}C_X)(U)$ be evaluation at $U$ of the composite of $f_*(\eta_g)$, the direct-image composition comparison, and $h_*$ of the inverse-image composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then $c_h(T_M z)=T_A(c_f z)$ for every $z\in(f_*M_Z)(U)$.

proof.text: Construct j_f as the two indicated natural isomorphisms. Coefficient forgetting is left adjoint: restrict scalars along the integer cast and compose with the integer-module/abelian-group equivalence. Sheafification commutes with this left adjoint, so Mathlib constantCommuteCompose supplies the first isomorphism. The second is the inverse of upperStarConstantSheafIso. Evaluate to construct c_f; no arbitrary existence witness is used.

The constantCommuteCompose comparison preserves sheafification generators. The constant pullback comparison is the uniqueness isomorphism of left adjoints to terminal evaluation, so its unit equation identifies its adjoint on each generator. Naturality of the unit moves j_f past the g-adjunction unit; the unit equation for inverse-image composition identifies the resulting composite with j_h. Apply lowerStar and the canonical direct-image composition comparison, then evaluate at U. This is precisely c_h T_M = T_A c_f. The construction also covers zero coefficients and empty schemes.

theorem constantModuleSectionCoefficientEquiv_naturality
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Etale)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (g : W ⟶ Z) (f : Z ⟶ X) (h : W ⟶ X)
    (w : g ≫ f = h)
    (z : ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
      ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj.obj
        (op U)) :
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let G := (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A).obj
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) A).obj M)
    constantModuleSectionCoefficientEquiv Λ M U h
        ((constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M f h g w).hom.app (op U) z) =
      ((lowerStar A f).map
          ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g).unit.app ((upperStar A f).obj G)) ≫
        (lowerStarComp A g f h w.symm).hom.app _ ≫
        (lowerStar A h).map ((upperStarComp A g f h w.symm).inv.app G)).hom.app
          (op U) (constantModuleSectionCoefficientEquiv Λ M U f z)
